recognize_zh: 這顆雙葉的嗜中性球在兩個核葉交界處的細胞質內有一顆小圓形淡色包涵體，疑為桑椹體（morula）；位於嗜中性球內應歸為 Anaplasma phagocytophilum，但包涵體很小，需以 PCR 或血清學確認。
features: Neutrophil with bilobed nucleus and fine cytoplasmic granules
Small round cytoplasmic inclusion adjacent to the nuclear lobes, compatible with a morula (small, limited resolution)
Normocytic red cells with rouleaux-free monolayer and no intraerythrocytic parasites
Blue-staining irregular fragment (upper right) consistent with stain precipitate or debris
Small platelet at the lower edge of the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a normocytic red cell population without intraerythrocytic parasites. A neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus contains a small round cytoplasmic inclusion near the nuclear lobes, compatible with a morula, although its small size limits confident identification. An irregular blue fragment in the field represents stain precipitate or debris. Findings are suggestive of granulocytic anaplasmosis (formerly human granulocytic ehrlichiosis) in the proper clinical context and should be confirmed by PCR or serology.

ddx.vs: Morulae reside in monocytes, not in neutrophils.
Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue peripheral patches and toxic vacuoles are empty, whereas a morula is a stippled basophilic cluster.
A platelet on top of a cell has a granular purple granulomere with pale hyalomere and sits outside the cell's focal plane.
Explains a bilobed nucleus but does not produce cytoplasmic inclusions.
